Three.js official example addons, version 0.160.1 (r160)
Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/three/v/0.160.1
Upstream: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r160/examples/jsm
Included: EffectComposer, RenderPass, SAOPass, UnrealBloomPass, OutputPass,
RoomEnvironment, Water, GLTFLoader, RGBELoader, ShaderPass, FXAAShader, SkeletonUtils.clone and dependencies.
The two loaders are optional local asset pipelines; no assets are fetched automatically.
Runtime imports are bound to globalThis.THREE by tools/build_rendering_addons.mjs.
